title: (RHBA-2017:2356) ostree bug fix and enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated ostree packages that fix one bug and add an enhancement are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 Extras.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
OSTree is a tool for managing bootable, immutable, versioned file system trees.

* The ostree packages have been changed to build also for the 64-bit ARM architecture, the little-endian variant of IBM Power Systems, and for IBM z Systems. (BZ#1448226)

Users of ostree are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix one bug and add this enhancement.
